sources.title: Our History — The seeds of Silicon Valley
sources.usage: Qualitative precedent for university research, commercialization and a university-developed research park; no figures or performance claims are imported into the proposal.
sources.limitations: Institutional history, not an independent impact evaluation. It does not substantiate venture-capital, open-source-culture, spatial-performance or direct transferability claims for the Jing-Zhang site.
usable_for: qualitative precedent on university research commercialization
qualitative precedent on a university-developed research park
not_usable_for: venture-capital or open-source-culture claims not stated by the source
independent impact, spatial-performance or direct-transferability conclusions
reproduction of Stanford names, marks or source imagery

sources.title: Kendall Square Initiative
sources.usage: Qualitative precedent for combining laboratories, innovation space, housing, retail and open space while strengthening collaboration in a campus-adjacent ecosystem; no figures are imported.
sources.limitations: MIT project self-description, not an independent post-occupancy or economic-impact evaluation. It does not establish a universal walking-distance threshold or prove that the same mix will perform similarly in Beijing.
usable_for: qualitative mixed-use and open-space precedent
qualitative campus-adjacent collaboration precedent
not_usable_for: universal walking-distance thresholds
independent post-occupancy, economic-impact or Beijing-transferability conclusions
reproduction of MIT names, marks or source imagery

sources.usage: Qualitative precedent for a compact knowledge cluster, cross-sector collaboration and accessible public realm; no membership counts or performance figures are imported.
sources.limitations: Partnership self-description, not a statutory planning boundary, heritage assessment or independent performance evaluation. Citation does not imply affiliation with, endorsement by or permission to reproduce partner brands.
usable_for: qualitative precedent on a compact knowledge cluster
qualitative precedent on cross-sector collaboration and accessible public realm
not_usable_for: statutory boundary, heritage-status or independent performance conclusions

usable_for: qualitative precedent on adaptive reuse of a former industrial site
qualitative precedent on mixed creative uses, research links and continuing experimentation
not_usable_for: independent heritage, sustainability or economic-impact conclusions

reproduction of project photographs, graphics or trademarks
